prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1355; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle presents right-side damage consistent with a sideswipe during a lane change: a scuffed and creased rear quarter panel, a cracked passenger-side mirror housing, and paint transfer along the door skin. The damage pattern lines up with the impact as described. The proposed repair plan calls for panel straightening, refinishing of the door and quarter panel, and replacement of the mirror assembly. The labor hours requested fit the extent of the damage. No prior damage to the vehicle is known, and the parts and charges listed on the invoices show no repeated entries. Recommend approval of the repair as presented.
